preamble: The voiceless dental fricative [θ] shifts to the voiceless bilabial fricative [ɸ] in Kaingang, the largest Southern Jê language of Brazil. Proto-Southern Jê *θ (itself from Proto-Jê *c) appears as ɸ in Kaingang in every position, whereas its sister Laklãnõ (Xokleng) voiced the same sound to ð; the Paulista dialect of Kaingang further varies between w and ɸ.

examples.note: Laklãnõ has ðy for the same word.

sources: Nikulin, A. (2020). Proto-Macro-Jê: um estudo reconstrutivo. https://repositorio.unb.br/handle/10482/38893
